text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening position and repeated claim that driverless cars are \"the new transportation system of America\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and returns to it consistently throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"references to half a million crash-free miles, taxi fuel savings, and automakers solving future problems","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It supports the argument with multiple specific details drawn from the article rather than mostly general comments."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on taxis, safety, alerts, and recalls","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in separate body points that are easier to follow than the other essay's mostly question-based flow."},{"evidence":"\"This is a good thing\" and \"This is great\" after each claim","quality":"claim development","description":"It explains why the evidence matters instead of only mentioning concerns or asking rhetorical questions."},{"evidence":"concluding sentence restating safety, testing, and future repairs","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by summarizing the main reasons in support of its position rather than trailing off."}]}
